CONSTRAINTS: You arrive at Nob Hill at 9:00AM. Emily will be at Richmond District from 7:00PM to 9:00PM. You'd like to meet Emily for a minimum of 15 minutes. Margaret will be at Financial District from 4:30PM to 8:15PM. You'd like to meet Margaret for a minimum of 75 minutes. Ronald will be at North Beach from 6:30PM to 7:30PM. You'd like to meet Ronald for a minimum of 45 minutes. Deborah will be at The Castro from 1:45PM to 9:15PM. You'd like to meet Deborah for a minimum of 90 minutes. Jeffrey will be at Golden Gate Park from 11:15AM to 2:30PM. You'd like to meet Jeffrey for a minimum of 120 minutes.

Your response should start with 'SOLUTION:'.

Please output the meeting schedule in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"action": "meet", "person": "<PERSON_NAME>", "start_time": "<HH:MM>", "end_time": "<HH:MM>"}]}. Make sure to include the person's name for each meeting.

SOLUTION:
The optimal schedule meets all five friends while satisfying the minimum time requirements and minimizing idle time. The itinerary is as follows:

- Start at Nob Hill at 9:00 AM.
- Depart Nob Hill at 11:13 AM to arrive at Golden Gate Park by 11:30 AM to meet Jeffrey.
- Meet Jeffrey from 11:30 AM to 1:30 PM (120 minutes, meeting the minimum).
- Depart Golden Gate Park at 1:30 PM to arrive at The Castro by 1:43 PM; wait until 1:45 PM to meet Deborah.
- Meet Deborah from 1:45 PM to 4:10 PM (145 minutes, exceeding the 90-minute minimum).
- Depart The Castro at 4:10 PM to arrive at Financial District by 4:30 PM to meet Margaret.
- Meet Margaret from 4:30 PM to 6:23 PM (113 minutes, exceeding the 75-minute minimum).
- Depart Financial District at 6:23 PM to arrive at North Beach by 6:30 PM to meet Ronald.
- Meet Ronald from 6:30 PM to 7:15 PM (45 minutes, meeting the minimum).
- Depart North Beach at 7:15 PM to arrive at Richmond District by 7:33 PM to meet Emily.
- Meet Emily from 7:33 PM to 7:48 PM (15 minutes, meeting the minimum).

This schedule ensures all friends are met with no conflicts and minimal waiting time.
